reason: The app's own packages are on the fixed Zod 4, and so is @ag-ui/core, whose schema the backend's run route reads a run with. CopilotKit (@copilotkit/runtime, core, shared and a2ui-renderer), @ag-ui/client, @ag-ui/proto and @a2ui/web_core declare Zod 3 as a dependency of their own, not a peer, so each keeps a nested Zod 3 copy. The copy on a request's path is the CopilotKit runtime's, which validates the frontend chat route's envelope; @ag-ui/client's reads the events of the app's own backend. Its cost is bounded where the body is read: a parsed body is held to a count of array elements and object keys before the runtime sees it (overElementLimit in platform/http), and the backend's run route keeps the same bound. It ends when those libraries depend on Zod 4.6.6 or later.

The development server's editor launcher. The site is built to static files and published as those; the server runs only on the machine of whoever is editing a page. VitePress 1 holds Vite at a major with no fixed release; it ends with a VitePress release on a fixed Vite.
